name: Samuel Sage: The Mystery at Penby Inn
source:
Immerse yourself in a thrilling mystery at the Penby Inn! A decadent hotel set in the endearing English countryside, Penby Inn is coming under a lot of fire (literally) from mind-boggling mishaps, ghoulish noises, rumours of hauntings and gruesome murder!

To adds to the drama, the rich new owner Samuel Sage, who has conveniently inherited the hotel, is completely clueless about the incendiary incidents, the drama ensuing behind its glamourous doors and the dark secrets it holds!

Will Samuel triumph over the increasingly insurmountable odds, or will he succumb to defeat? Will he shatter under the weight of the heavy burden, or will the sweet refuge of a budding romance see him through the turmoil?

During the course of the game, you will join Samuel Sage to explore the hotel, examine evidence of hauntings, gather clues by talking to customers, contractors and employees; uncover scandalous secrets from his familial past and unravel the dark motives behind the horrific murder in Penby Inn. To take your mind off the grave and increasingly mysterious happenings, you can explore the charming history of the deliciously delightful Penby village and even indulge in a bit of spirited romance!

The game comes with convenient features such as a log for re-examining saved evidence and studying artefacts gathered during exploration. The game is available with English subtitles.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2579570/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
潘比旅館裡，一樁樁驚險的謎案正等著你！這家奢華旅館坐落在迷人的英格蘭鄉間，近來可謂處處起火，有時還真得救火。離奇的事故、讓人發毛的聲響、鬧鬼的傳聞，甚至還有一樁駭人的謀殺案！

偏偏剛剛繼承旅館的富有新主人塞繆爾．塞奇，對那些火災、華麗大門背後的紛爭，以及旅館深藏的黑暗秘密，全都一無所知！

面對越來越難以克服的困境，塞繆爾能扭轉局面，還是終將認輸？重擔會將他壓垮，還是一段剛萌芽的甜蜜戀情會成為他的避風港，陪他熬過風浪？

你將和塞繆爾一起探索旅館，檢驗鬧鬼的證據，與住客、承包商和員工交談，蒐集線索，揭開他家族往昔見不得光的醜聞，查明潘比旅館兇案背後的陰暗動機。要是想從這些沉重而又越來越蹊蹺的事裡歇一會兒，也可以去可愛的潘比村探尋當地歷史，甚至盡情談一場熱烈的戀愛！

遊戲提供記錄簿，方便你回顧已儲存的證據、研究探索途中收集的物品。遊戲配有英文字幕。

〔摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2579570/]Steam[/url]〕
